content:
The BUILT CoLAB continues to support ATIC in drawing up C2Ø – Construction to Zero, the Decarbonisation Roadmap for the construction supply chain and associated industrial activities.

As part of the C2Ø Accelerator activity, which aims to prepare companies in the sectors covered by the Roadmap for the adoption of decarbonisation strategies, BUILT CoLAB is organising four Capacity-Building Actions: Ecodesign, Digital Factories, End of Life of Buildings, and Life Cycle Assessment Metrics.

These Actions will take place in three different NUTS regions:

Porto, 27 March – Ordem dos Engenheiros Região Norte 

Lisbon, 1 April – Ordem dos Engenheiros Região Sul

Coimbra, 3 April – Itecons

All sessions include coffee breaks and lunch. Participation is free of charge, but registration is mandatory and must be made here.

Back in February, BUILT CoLAB organised the Initial Consultation Workshop under C2Ø – Construction to Zero, which aimed to discuss and validate the material and energy flows of each of the sectors covered by the roadmap and of the construction sector as a whole. Around 60 industry experts attended the digital event, contributing their perspective and technical knowledge, of great importance to the work under way.

As a reminder, C2Ø – Construction to Zero is a joint project of PTPC – Plataforma Tecnológica Portuguesa da Construção and ATIC – Associação Portuguesa de Cimento, with the support of 3drivers and BUILT CoLAB, and is co-financed by the European Union – NextGenerationEU, under the PRR – Recovery and Resilience Plan. BUILT CoLAB provides specialised technical assistance services, such as research and consultancy relevant to drawing up the Roadmap, as well as communication and dissemination of its actions.
